headline: Equities and wealth drive growth, profit trails last quarter
summary_short: Morgan Stanley reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $20.3B (+11.6% y/y) and diluted EPS of $3.03 (+8.2%), with ROTCE of 22.6% and Equity revenue up 41%.
summary_long: Net revenues rose to $20.3B from $18.2B a year ago. Institutional Securities earned $10.0B as Equity jumped 41% to $5.8B, while Fixed Income fell 7%. Wealth Management set a record $9.1B with $232B of net new assets, and client assets reached $10.5T. Investment Management revenue fell 12% on a carried-interest reversal. Non-compensation expenses rose on execution and technology costs and the provision for credit losses was $148M against nil. Net income was $4.91B and ROTCE was 22.6%. The firm repurchased $1.5B of stock and declared a $1.15 quarterly dividend.
confidence_notes: The 8-K cover is a short stub; the earnings release was identified from the filing folder listing (the exhibit resolver found no EX-99 label, so the release file was chosen from the candidates). The q/q net income delta uses Q2 2026 net income of $5,581M from the release's own table; the q/q diluted EPS delta uses $3.46 from the existing MS Q2 2026 summary (the shard's $3.47 is basic EPS). Y/y deltas use the release's own comparatives. Net revenues now exclude DCP mark-to-market gains per the release's presentation change. The release states no forward guidance.

drivers.explanation: The CEO says Institutional Securities benefited from global strength led by Equity, and Wealth Management reported record revenues with $232B of net new assets.

Equity net revenues rose 41% on client engagement and strength in Asia; Wealth Management reached a record on asset management fees and higher net interest income; Fixed Income fell 7% on credit and commodities.
Revenue growth outpaced expenses: compensation rose on higher revenues and non-compensation expenses rose on execution-related costs and technology spend; the efficiency ratio held at 67%.
Net income fell from $5.58B last quarter; the release does not give a q/q explanation.
Not explained in the release beyond the earnings and equity figures shown; tangible book value per share rose to $53.96 from $48.64.
